{{Quote|They're destroying our base. Hurry!|Bravo Twelve to Rhys Dallows|<ref name="SW:SF" />}}
A [[Naboo Resistance]] '''base''' was established in the [[Naboo training canyon]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The base had a number of tents for its personnel, two [[Medcenter/Legends|hospitals]], and [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser turrets]] for defense. [[Rhys Dallows]] [[Mission in the Naboo canyon|agreed to deliver supplies]] to the base. He escorted [[Reti]] through the canyon and assisted in the resistance in fighting off a large [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] force.

==Characteristics==
{{Expandsect}}
A [[Naboo Resistance]] base was was established in the [[Naboo training canyon]] after the start<ref name="SW:SF" /> of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> The base consisted of a number of tents, two [[Medcenter/Legends|hospitals]], and a number of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser turretss]] for defense.<ref name="SW:SF" />

==History==
After the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] occupied the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the resistance, formed from the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], established the base. [[Bravo Twelve]] and [[Unidentified N-1 starfighter pilot|Bravo Eight]] were among the forces stationed there. After his return to Naboo, [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Rhys Dallows]] agreed to transport [[Skirmish over Naboo|captured]] munitions to the base. When he arrived at the canyon, his escorts were not there, so he led [[Reti]], carrying the munitions in his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Zoomer]]'', into the canyon. They found the escorts in a [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]] with [[Scarab-class starfighter/Legends|Scarab starfighters]]. Together they finished off the Scarabs and continued onto the base, which had fallen under attack by a large force of Trade Federation [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]] and [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]]. The resistance fighters destroyed the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] forces and saved the base.<ref name="SW:SF" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Don't shoot our turrets!|A reminder to the player to avoid friendly fire|<ref name="SW:SF" />}}
The resistance base appears in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]. It is also mentioned in the game's [[Star Wars: Starfighter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]].
